Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Nikhil - 12 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya dances to the music.]

Aditya (excited): "I'm ready!"

[Aditya sings a song.]

Aditya (happily): "Show me too!"

[Aditya waves goodbye to Mother.]

Aditya (happily): "Yes, all right."

[Aditya takes the bag from Mother.]

Aditya: "And then?"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Aditya stands on the terrace. Anita stands near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya flies a kite on the terrace.]

Aditya: "And then?"

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

Anita: "Nikhil, look over here."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Nikhil: "Aunty, look at this."

[Aditya makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Aditya: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aditya builds a snowman.]

Anita (gently): "That's great!"

[Aditya catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Anita: "Okay, Nikhil."

[Aditya slides down the snowy slope.]

Nikhil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
